sbh2.0:0.2: Yogasthāna II — Pudgalas, Trainings, and Awakening Topics
sbh2.0:1.1: laukikaṁ caiva vairāgyaṁ tathā lokottareṇa ca |
sbh2.0:2.1: tatra kati pudgalā yesyāṁ naiṣkramyabhūmau yathādeśitāyāṁ yathāparikīrttitāyāṁ niṣkrāmanti |
sbh2.0:3.2: yena pudgalena pūrvamanyāsu jātiṣu rāga āsevito, bhāvito, bahulīkṛtaḥ sa tena hetunā tena pratyayainaitarhi raṁjanīye vastuni tīvrarāgaśca, bhavatyāyata na rāgaśca |
sbh2.0:3.5: yena pudgalena dveṣaḥ pūrvamanyāsu jātiṣu āsevito, bhāvito, bahulīkṛtaḥ |
sbh2.0:3.6: tena hetunā tena pratyayenaitarhi dveṣaṇīye vastuni tīvradveṣaśca bhavatyāyatadveṣaśca |
sbh2.0:3.10: yena pudgalena pūrvamanyāsu jātiṣu moha āsevito, bhāvito, bahulīkṛtaḥ |
sbh2.0:3.12: etarhi mohanīye vastuni tīvramohaśca bhavatyāyata mohaścāyamucyate mohonmadaḥ pudgalaḥ |
sbh2.0:3.14: yena pudgalena pūrvamanyāsu jātiṣu māna āsevito, bhāvito, bahulīkṛtastena hetunā tena pratyayena |
sbh2.0:3.15: etarhi manyanīye mānanīye vastuni tīvramānaśca bhavatyāyatamānaśca |
sbh2.0:4.3: yena pudgalena pūrvamanyāsu jātiṣu vitarka āsevito, bhāvito, bahulīkṛtastena ca hetunā tena ca pratyayena etarhi vitarka sthānīye vastuni tīvravitarkaśca bhavatyāyatavitarkaśca |
sbh2.0:5.2: yena pudgalena pūrvamanyāsu jātiṣu rāgo, dveṣo, moho, māno, vitarko nāsevito, bhāvito, bahulīkṛto, na caite dharmā ādīnavato dṛṣṭāḥ |
sbh2.0:5.4: sa tena hetunā, tena ca pratyayena raṁjanīye vā vastuni, dveṣaṇīye vā vastuni, manyanīye mānanīye , vitarkaṇīye vā vastuni na tīvrarāgo bhavati |
sbh2.0:5.6: na cāsya samudācarati rāgo, yaduta tena vastunā |
sbh2.0:5.7: yathā rāga evaṁ dveṣo, moho, māno, vitarkaḥ |
sbh2.0:5.10: yena pudgalena pūrvamanyāsu jātiṣu na rāga āsevito bhavati, bahulīkṛtaḥ |
sbh2.0:5.13: sa tena hetunā tena pratyayenaitarhi raṁjanīye vastuni samavahite, saṁmukhībhūte, adhimātre, pracure, udva ulva ṇe rajyaṁ rāgamutpādayati |
sbh2.0:5.15: yathā rāga evaṁ dveṣo, moho, māno, vitarkā rko , veditavyāḥ vyaḥ |

sbh2.0:13.2: yoyaṁ pudgalastrayāṇāṁ saṁyojanānāṁ prahāṇātsatkāyadṛṣṭeḥ, śīlavrataparāmarśasya, vicikitsāyāḥ strota āpanno bhavati |

sbh2.0:13.8: yasya sakṛdāgāminaḥ pudgalasya anāgāmiphalapratipannakasya kāmāvacarāṇāṁ kleśānāmadhimātramadhyadeśāḥ prahīṇā bhavanti |
sbh2.0:14.5: cyutamātra evāntarābhavābhinirvṛttikāle antarābhavamabhinirvatayatyabhinirvṛtte ḥ samakālameva parinirvāti |

sbh2.0:24.10: nātyarthaṁ pareṣāṁ viheṭhanajātīyo yaduta kāyena, vācā durvivejyaśca bhavati, duḥsaṁvejyaśca |

sbh2.0:25.2: iha moha caritaḥ pudgalaḥ mohasthānīye vastuni parīttaṁ, ghanaṁ, prabhūtaṁ mohaparyavasthānamutpādayati |

sbh2.0:25.9: mattendriyaśca, śithilakāyakaryānta nto duścintitacintī, durbhāṣitabhāṣī, duṣkṛtakarmakārī, alaso ’nutthānasampannaḥ |

sbh2.0:26.11: uddhatendriyaśca bhavatyunnatendriyaśco nnatendriyaśca kāyamaṇḍanānuyuktaśca bhavatyadhimātramunnatāñca vācaṁ bhāṣate, nāvanatāṁ, sātāpikagurusthānīyānāṁ ca na kālena kālaṁ yathārūpāmapacitiṁ kartā bhavati |
sbh2.0:26.13: apraṇatakāyo nābhi vādanavandanapratyutthānānāṁ jālisāmīcīkarmaśīla, ātmapragrāhako bhavatyātmotkarṣo parapaṁsakaḥ |

sbh2.0:26.39: dakṣonalasa ityevaṁ bhāgīyāni vitarkacaritasya pudgalasya liṁgāni veditavyāni |
sbh2.0:28.8: tatrayoyaṁ pudgalaḥ pratyekāyāṁ bodhau kṛtapraṇidhānaḥ so ’pi syātpratyekabuddhagotraḥ, syācchāvakagotraḥ, syānmahāyānagotraḥ |

sbh2.0:75.17: tatra samāhitaṁ cittaṁ yannivaraṇavimokṣānmauladhyānapraviṣṭaṁ, na susamāhitaṁ yadapraviṣṭaṁ |
sbh2.0:75.18: tatra subhāvitaṁ cittaṁ yadasyaiva samādherdīrghakālaparicayānnikāmalābhī bhavatyakṛcchralābhī |
sbh2.0:75.23: cittaṁ yanna sarvato nā nā pyatyantato vimuktamitīmāni caturdaśa cittāni |
sbh2.0:75.25: tatra nivaraṇabhūviśuddhā ddhi bhūmimārabhya vihāragatānyaṣṭau cittāni veditavyāni |
sbh2.0:75.27: kleśaviśuddhiṁ punarārabhya vihāragatāni ṣaṭ cittāni yāvatsuvimuktaṁ cittaṁ na suvimuktamiti |
sbh2.0:75.28: yatpunaḥ satyadhyātmaṁ nivaraṇe asti me nivaraṇamiti jānāti |
sbh2.0:75.29: asati nivaraṇe nāsti me nivaraṇamiti jānāti |
sbh2.0:75.33: yatra sati cakṣuḥsaṁyojane yāvatpunaḥ nmana saṁyojane asti me yāvatpunaḥ manaḥ saṁyojanamiti |
sbh2.0:75.34: asati yāvatpunaḥ nmanaḥ saṁyojane nāsti me manaḥ saṁyojanamiti prajānāti |
sbh2.0:75.39: satyadhyātmaṁ smṛtisaṁbodhyaṁge asti me smṛti saṁbodhyaṁgamiti prajānāti |
sbh2.0:75.46: satyadhyātmaṁ smṛtisaṁbodhyaṁgamevaṁ dharmavinayavīryapraśrabdhisamādhyupekṣāsaṁbodhyaṁgaṁ veditavyamiti yadevaṁ svabhāvādīnavapratipakṣākāraiḥ saṁkliṣṭadharmaparijñānamidaṁ śarīraṁ dharmasmṛtyupasthānasya, yathā kāye kāyānupaśyanā smṛtyupasthānapakṣame kṣae vaṁ vedanā yāṁ yaccitte yāvaccite dharmeṣu yathāyogaṁ veditavyam |
sbh2.0:75.49: yadā adhyātmaṁ pratyātmaṁ satva ttva saṁkhyāte kāye kāyānupaśyī darśī viharati |
sbh2.0:75.52: yadā adhyātmaṁ pratyātmaṁ, yadā bahirdhā asattvasaṁkhyātaṁ rūpamālambanīkarotyevaṁ bahirdhākāye kāyānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:75.53: yadā bahirdhā rdho paraktaṁ sattvasaṁkhyātaṁ rūpamālambanīkarotyevamadhyātmabahirdhā kāye kāyānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:75.57: adhyātmaṁ vedanā yāṁ , citte, dharmeṣu dharmānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:75.60: bahirdhā vedanāyāṁ, citte, dharmeṣu dharmānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:75.62: yā utpannā vedanā, cittaṁ, dharmāstānālambanīkurvannadhyātmabahirdhā vedanāyāṁ, citte dharmeṣu dharmānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:76.2: indriyasaṁgṛhītaṁ rūpamālambanīkurvan, adhyātmaṁ kāye kāyānupaśyī darśī viharati |
sbh2.0:76.6: rūpamadhyātmamupagatamupādattaṁ rūpamālambanīkurvannadhyātmabahirdhā kāye kāyānupaśyī darśī viharati |
sbh2.0:76.7: anindriyasaṁgṛhītaṁ rūpagatamanupādattamālambanīkurvan bahirdhā kāye kāyānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:76.8: anindriyasaṁgṛhītameva rūpamadhyātmamupagatamupādattaṁ rūpamālambanīkurvannadhyātmabahirdhā kāye kāyānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:76.10: yadu yo tpannā vedanā, cittaṁ, dharmāstānyathāyogamālambanīkurvan tathādarśī viharatīti veditavyaṁ |
sbh2.0:76.12: yatsamāhitabhūmikaṁ praśrabdhisahagataṁ rūpamālambanīkarotyevamadhyātmaṁ kāye kāyānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:76.14: evaṁ bahirdhā kāye kāyānupaśyī darśī viharati |
sbh2.0:76.15: paradauṣṭhulyasahagataṁ praśrabdhisahagataṁ ca rūpamālambanīkurvan adhyātmabahirdhā kāye |
sbh2.0:76.17: evaṁ tadupādāyotpannā vedanā, cittaṁ, dharmā aparaḥ paryāyaḥ |
sbh2.0:76.19: bāhyaṁ bhūtarūpamālambanī kurvan bahirdhā kāye kāyānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:76.23: evaṁ tadupādāya yā utpannā vedanā cittaṁ dharmāstepi yathāyogaṁ veditavyāḥ |
sbh2.0:76.29: a sa vijñānakasya ca rūpasyātīte kāle savijñānatāṁ |
sbh2.0:76.30: avijñāna ka sya ca rūpasyānāgate kāle avijñānatāṁ, tulyadharmatāṁ, samadharmatāṁ ālambanīkurvannadhyātmabahirdhā kāye kāyānudarśī viharatyevaṁ tadupādāya, yā utpannā vedanā, cittaṁ, dharmāstepi yathāyogaṁ veditavyāḥ |
sbh2.0:76.32: ātmanaḥ anta ḥ kāyaṁ keśaromanakhādibhiḥ ākārairālambanīkurvannadhyātmabahirdhā kāye kāyānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:77.1: pareṣāmantaḥ kāyaṁ keśaromanakhādibhirākārairālambanīkurvanbahirdhā kāye kāyānudarśī viharatyadhyātmaṁ cittaṁ ca bahiḥkāyavipariṇataṁ vinīlakādibhirākāraiḥ |
sbh2.0:77.3: vinīlakādibhirākāraistulyadharmatayā ālambanīkurvan bahirdhā kāye kāyānudarśī viharati |
sbh2.0:77.4: tadupādāya yā utpannā vedanā, cittaṁ, dharmāstepi yathāyogaṁ veditavyāḥ |
sbh2.0:77.8: tatra caturṇāmviparyāsānāṁ pratipakṣeṇa bhagavatā catvāri smṛtyupasthānāni vyavasthāpitāni |
sbh2.0:77.9: tatrāśucau śucīti viparyāse pratipakṣeṇa kāyasmṛtyupasthānaṁ vyavasthāpitaṁ |
sbh2.0:77.17: yatkiṁcidveditamidamatra duḥkhasyeti yathābhūtaṁ prajānātyevamasya yo duḥkhasukhe sukhamiti |
sbh2.0:77.22: tasya sarāgādicittaprabhedena teṣāṁ teṣāṁ rātriṁdivasānāmatyayātkṣaṇalavamuhūrttānā ṇā manekavidhānāṁ bahunānāprakāratāṁ cittasyopalabhya yaḥ anitye nityamiti viparyāsaḥ sa prahīyate |
sbh2.0:77.23: yatrā nā tmanyātmeti viparyāsapratipakṣeṇa dharmasmṛtyupasthānaṁ vyavasthāpitaṁ |
sbh2.0:77.24: tasya yeṣāṁ ātmadṛṣṭyādikā nāṁ saṁkleśānāṁ sadbhāvādyeṣāṁ nānātmadṛṣṭyādikānāṁ kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāmasadbhāvātskandheṣvātma darśanaṁ bhavati |
sbh2.0:77.31: skandheṣu skandhamātraṁ, dharmamātraṁ, yathābhūtamaprajānan yathā kāye āśritaḥ |
sbh2.0:77.32: yadāśritaśca sukhaduḥkha ja dharmādharmābhyāṁ saṁkliśyate vyavadā dī yate ca |
sbh2.0:77.36: yatraiva ca te citte, manasi, vijñāne, ātmagrāheṇa aparaḥ paryāyaḥ |
sbh2.0:77.51: viśudhyate yataśca yaśca yena saṁkliśyate viśudhyate ca |
sbh2.0:77.62: tatra yā prajñā smṛtiśca samādhisaṁgrāhikā tatsvabhāvasmṛtyupasthānaṁ |
sbh2.0:77.65: api ca kāyavedanādhipateyo mārgaḥ samutpannaḥ kuśalaḥ sāsravaḥ |
sbh2.0:78.1: sa evaṁ caturṣu smṛtyupasthāneṣu kṛtaparicaya audāriko kau dārikaṁ viparyāsamapīnaya kuśalākuśaladharmābhijñaḥ |
sbh2.0:78.5: utpannānāṁ sthitaya iti vistareṇa pūrvavadyāvaccittaṁ pragṛhṇāti |
sbh2.0:79.1: tatra katame pāpakā akuśalā dharmā ḥ |
sbh2.0:79.2: yatkāmāvacaraṁ kliṣṭaṁ kāyakarma, vākkarma, manaskarma, kāyavāṅmanoduścaritasaṁgṛhītaṁ |
sbh2.0:79.3: yena tatsamutthāpakāḥ kleśāste punarye asamavahitā, asaṁmukhībhūtāste utpannā, ye samavahitāḥ saṁmukhībhūtāste utpannāḥ |
sbh2.0:79.4: tatra kuśalā dharmā ye tatprātipakṣikā dharmāduścaritaprātipakṣikā, nivaraṇaprātipakṣikāḥ, saṁyojanaprātipakṣikā vā tepyanutpannāstathaiva veditavyāḥ |
sbh2.0:79.5: utpannāśca pāpakā akuśalā dharmāstatra yadā anutpannānāṁ pāpakānāmakuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāmanutpādāya spṛhāmutpādayati |
sbh2.0:79.6: praṇidhatte, sarveṇa sarvaṁ sarvathā notpādayiṣyāmītyevaṁ chandaṁ janayati |
sbh2.0:79.8: prativinodayiṣyāmi ya da nutpanneṣu pāpakeṣvakuśaleṣu pūrva mevotpāda |
sbh2.0:79.13: te punaḥ pāpakā akuśalā dharmā atītavastvālambanā vā, anāgatavastvālambanā vā, vartamānaviṣayālambanā vā utpadyante, bhavanti |
sbh2.0:79.14: yenoktaviṣayālambanā ḥ , pratyakṣaviṣayālambanāśca ye atītānāgatāvasthālambanāste, ye coktaviṣayālambanā, ye vartamānaviṣayālambanāste pratyakṣaviṣayālambanā ḥ |
sbh2.0:79.32: yathā atīte ālambane evamanāgate a pi veditavyam |
sbh2.0:79.33: evamayamanutpannānāṁ pāpakānāmakuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāmanutpādāyotpannānāṁ ca prahāṇāya vyāyacchata ityucyate |
sbh2.0:79.34: sa cedayamvarttamāne ālambane carati, tathā tathā carati |
sbh2.0:79.43: santi pāpakā akuśalā dharmā ye saṁkalpavaśe bale notpadyante |
sbh2.0:79.50: tatra saṁkleśavaśe le na ca viṣayabalena cotpadyate nte |
sbh2.0:79.56: tatra ye viṣayaba lena saṁkalpaba lena cotpadyante |
sbh2.0:79.58: utpannānāñca prahāṇāya vyāyaccha te tatra ye viṣayabalena saṁkalpabalena cotpadyante |
sbh2.0:79.60: tatrānutpannānāṁ kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāmanu mu tpādāya chandaṁ janayatīti |
sbh2.0:79.61: ye kuśalādharmā apratilabdhā a saṁmukhībhūtasya tāḥ teṣāṁ pratilambhāya saṁmukhībhāvāya ca smṛti mutpādayati |
sbh2.0:79.66: kṛ ya ttu utpannānāṁ ca kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāṁ sthitaye, asaṁmoṣāya, bhāvanāparipūraye chandaṁ janayatīti |
sbh2.0:79.67: utpannāḥ kuśalā dharmā ye pratilabdhāssaṁmukhībhūtāśca, tatra pratilaṁbhāvigamaṁ pratilabdhāṁ pārihāṇimadhikṛtyāha |
sbh2.0:79.76: utpannānāṁ kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāṁ sthitaye asaṁmoṣāya bhāvanāparipūraye c chandaḥ |
sbh2.0:79.82: bhāvanāparipūraye, api ca mṛdumadhyānāṁ kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāmanutpannānāmutpādāya, utpannānāṁ ca sthitaye |
sbh2.0:79.84: adhimātrāṇāṁ kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāmanutpannānāmutpādāya, utpannānāṁ ca yāvad bhāvanāparipūraye vīryamārabhate |
sbh2.0:79.93: evaṁ vistareṇa yāvadutpannānāṁ kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāṁ sthitaye |
sbh2.0:79.97: tadā anyatamānyatamena pragrāhakena ṇa nimittena prasadanīyena pratigṛhṇāti |
sbh2.0:79.106: utpannānāṁ ca prahāṇāya c chando vyāyāmo vīryārambhaḥ |
sbh2.0:79.110: tadyathā kṛṣṇapakṣyāṇāṁ tatraikaṁ samvaraṇaprahāṇaṁ yadutpannānāmpāpakānāmakuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāṁ prahāṇāya c chandaṁ janayatīti vistareṇa |
sbh2.0:79.111: dvitīyaṁ prahāṇaprahāṇaṁ yadanutpannānāmanutpādāya c chandaṁ janayatīti vistareṇa, utpannaṁ hi saṁvarayitavyaṁ |
sbh2.0:79.113: anutpannaṁ ca yattadasamudācārataḥ prahīṇamevaṁ tadasaṁmukhībhāvataḥ prahātavyamiti kṛtvā |
sbh2.0:79.116: anutpannānāṁ kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāmutpādāyeti vistareṇa yāvaccittaṁ pragṛhṇāti, pradadhātīti |
sbh2.0:79.117: tathā hi kuśalā dharmā āsevyamānā, bhāvyamānā, apratilabdhāśca pratilabhyante |
sbh2.0:79.126: sā kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāṁ sthitaye, asammoṣāya, bhāvanāparipūraye |
sbh2.0:79.127: evamanutpannāḥ kuśalā dharmā anurakṣitā bhavantyayaṁ tāvatsamyakprahāṇānāṁ vistaravibhāgaḥ |
sbh2.0:79.138: yatprahātavyasya vustanaḥ prahāṇāya, prāptavyasya vastunaḥ prāptaye pūrvameva spṛhājātena bhavitavyaṁ, paryavasthānaprahāṇāya, vīryamārabdhavyamanuśayaprahāṇāya ca, kālena kālaṁ śamathapragrahopekṣānimittāni bhāvayitavyāni |
sbh2.0:79.139: paryavasthānaprahāṇānuśayaprahāṇāya ca ye prātipakṣikā dharmāḥ kuśalāste samudānayitavyāḥ |
sbh2.0:79.140: taccaitatsarvaṁ caturbhiḥ samyakprahāṇaiḥ paridīpitaṁ bhavatyayaṁ samāsārthaḥ |
sbh2.0:80.3: tatra chanda samādhi madhipatiṁ kṛtvā yaḥ pratilabhyate samādhirayaṁ chandasamādhiḥ |
sbh2.0:80.4: vīryaṁ, cittaṁ, mīmāṁsāmadhipati kṛtvā pratilabhyate pratilabhyate samādhirayaṁ ........... mīmānsā māṁsā samādhiḥ |
sbh2.0:80.6: chandajātaśca tānpāpakānakuśalāndharmān svabhāvato, nidānata, ādīnavataḥ, pratipakṣataśca |
sbh2.0:80.9: evaṁ kuśalā n dharmāssva dharmānsva bhāvato nidānataśca |
sbh2.0:80.17: sa sā atītā te vā, anāgatapratyutpanne vā punarālambane pāpakākuśalādharmāsthānīye ladharmasthānīye mṛdumadhyādhimātrakleśasamavasthānīye, anutpannasya vā anutpādāya, utpannasya vā prahāṇāya, vyāyacchamāno vīryamāramamāṇaḥ |
sbh2.0:80.18: tatrālambane vicaratyantasya vālambanasya svabhāvato nidānataḥ pratipakṣataśca |
sbh2.0:80.27: yatpāpakānāmakuśalānāndharmāṇāṁ pāpakākuśalā la dharmasthānīyānvayāt kuśala ta ḥ |
sbh2.0:80.28: kuśalāndharmān kuśalākuśalasthānīyāṁśca dharmān svabhāvato, nidānata, ādīnavataḥ, anuśaṁsataḥ, pratipakṣato, niḥsaraṇataḥ, samyagupani da dhyāyataḥ |
sbh2.0:80.30: tadbahulavihāriṇo yā utpadyante cittasyaikāgratāḥ vistareṇa yāvadayaṁ |
sbh2.0:80.32: tatra ye pāpakākuśalā la dharmasthānīyā dharmā bhavanti |
sbh2.0:80.38: samādhipramukheṣu dharmeṣvanutpanneṣu te pāpakā akuśalā dharmā dharma mudā haranti |
sbh2.0:80.41: asaṁvidyamānānyanva nnva haṁ parimīmānse māṁsaye yaṁ |
sbh2.0:80.42: sa mīmānsā māṁsā manaskāramadhipatiṁ kṛtvā prahīṇāprahīṇatāṁ mīmānsa māṁsa te samyagevopanidhyāpayati |
sbh2.0:80.43: tadbahulavihārī ca spṛśati cittasyaikāgratāṁ yena ca nirabhimāno bhavati |
sbh2.0:80.44: paryavasthānamātrakācya cca cittaṁ vimuktaṁ, na tu sarveṇa sarvaṁmanuśayebhyaḥ |
sbh2.0:80.45: tatpratipakṣāśca me samādhipramukhāḥ kuśalā dharmā ś ca pratilabdhā, bhāvitā, na tvanuśayaprātipākṣikā iti yathābhūtaṁ prajānāti |
sbh2.0:80.47: sa taṁ caturvidhaṁ samādhimadhipatiṁ kṛtvā paryavasthāneṣu dūrīkṛteṣu |
sbh2.0:80.48: sarveṇa sarvamanuśayasamudghātāya pāpakānāmakuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāṁ, tatprātipākṣikāṇāñca kuśalānāṁ |
sbh2.0:80.50: vyāyacchata iti vistareṇa caturbhiḥ samyakprahāṇaiḥ prayujyate |
sbh2.0:80.53: samādhiparipūraye ca tadyathā- chandaḥ kadācitsamādhiṁ paripūrayiṣyāmi |
sbh2.0:80.59: yacchraddhāpramādapūrvaṁgamaṁ prāmodyaṁ, prītiḥ, prītamanasaścānupūrvā pāpakākuśalā dharmapakṣasya dauṣṭhulyasya pratipraśrabdhiḥ |
sbh2.0:80.60: tatra smṛtiryā navākārā navākārāyāścittasthiteḥ śamathapakṣyāyāḥ saṁgrāhikā |
sbh2.0:80.64: prahīṇāprahīṇato mīmānsa māṁsa mānasya yaścittābhisaṁskāraḥ śamathavipaśyanānukūlaḥ kāyakarma vākkarma samutthāpayati |
sbh2.0:80.66: ābhyāṁ dvābhyāṁ kāraṇābhyāṁ prahīṇatāmanuśayānāṁ paricchinatti jānāti |
sbh2.0:80.67: yaduta viṣayaviparokṣayā cetanayā viṣayaviparokṣayā cā co pekṣayā |
sbh2.0:80.69: te caiteṣṭau sa caiṣo ’ṣṭa prahāṇasaṁskārayogo bhavatyanuśayasamudghātāya |
sbh2.0:80.70: tatra chanda cchanda śca, eta ṣa eva yo vyāyāmaḥ idaṁ vīryaṁ, yāśraddhā sā śuddhā, yā ca praśrabdhiryā ca smṛtiryacca saṁprajanyaṁ |
sbh2.0:80.74: ye ca ime prahāṇasaṁskārāḥ prahīṇeṣvanuśayeṣu, parikṣipte samādhau, chandasamādhiprahāṇasaṁskārasamanvāgata ṛddhipāda ityucyante te |
sbh2.0:80.79: yasya pādaḥ samvidyate so a bhikramapratikrama ma parākramasamartho bhavati |
sbh2.0:80.83: sa evaṁ pariśuddhe citte, paryavadāte, anaṁgaṇe, vigatopakleśe, ṛjubhūte karmaṇyasthite, āniṁjyaprāpte, abhikramapratikramasamartho bhavati |
sbh2.0:80.85: eṣā hi parā ṛddhiḥ, parā samṛddhiḥ |
sbh2.0:80.86: yaduta lokottarā dharmāstenocyante te ṛddhipāda iti |
sbh2.0:81.3: adhi cittaṁ śikṣā yā madhiprajñaṁ śikṣāyāṁ yogaṁ karoti |
sbh2.0:81.5: pareṣāṁ cādhigame śāstuḥ śrāvakāṇāṁ ca yo a bhisaṁpratyayaḥ |
sbh2.0:81.11: ye a pi te vīryādayaḥ teṣāmapi lokottaradharmotpattaye ādhipatyaṁ |
sbh2.0:81.16: yā punaḥ pūrveṇāparaṁ viśeṣādhigamaṁ sajānataḥ saṁjānataḥ |

sbh2.0:104.113: yathoktādbhūrādhikakasamudācārāya c chandajāto viherayu ret mu mū kajāta ārubdhavīryaścāyamucyate samādhisaṁbhārarakṣopacayaḥ |
sbh2.0:104.114: sa evaṁ hānabhāgīyāṁśca dharmān virajyati, śeṣabhāgīyāṁśca dharmān pratiṣevamāṇaḥ praviviktavihārī bhavati |
sbh2.0:104.118: araṇyamvā, vṛkṣamūlamvā, śūnyāgāramvā-tatra parvatakandaraṁ vā, giriguhā vā, palālapuṁjāni vā śūnyāgāramityucyate |
sbh2.0:104.125: darśanīyaṁ prāsādikamārāmasampannaṁ, vanasampannaṁ, puṣkariṇīsampannaṁ, śubhaṁ, ramaṇīyaṁ, notkūlanikūlaṁ, na sthāṇukaṇṭakadhānaṁ |
sbh2.0:104.132: punarayaṁ ridaṁ na divā alpavilokaṁ bhavati |
sbh2.0:104.138: punaraparaṁ ye te ānulomikā jīvitapariṣkārāścī varādayaḥ |
sbh2.0:104.145: gaṁbhīraṁ cārthapadaṁ prajñayā pratividhya suṣṭhu ca prakāśayanti |
sbh2.0:104.150: niṣadya yāvatā evaṁ rātryāḥ prathamaṁ yāmaṁ, madhyame na ca yāme dakṣiṇena pārśvena ṇa śayyāṁ kalpayati |
sbh2.0:104.153: tasminnidaṁ sampanne śayanāsane, tathā buddhānujñāte mañce vā, pīṭhe vā, tṛṇe vā, saṁstaraṇe vā niṣīdati |
sbh2.0:104.155: kena kāraṇena pañca kāraṇāni samanupaśyan saṁpiṇḍitena kāyena praśrabdhirutpadyate |
sbh2.0:104.157: tathā cārikā kā laṁ niṣadyayāśakto vyatināmayituṁ |
sbh2.0:104.161: tathā pare aneneryāpathena niṣaṇṇaṁ dṛṣṭvā atyarthamabhiprasīdanti buddhaiśca buddhaśrāvakaiścāyaṁ īryāpatho niṣevitaścānujñātaśca |
sbh2.0:104.168: tatra ṛjunā kāyena pragṛhītena styānamiddhaṁ cittaṁ na paryādāya tiṣṭhati |
sbh2.0:104.169: niṣkuhakena citte bahirdhā vikṣepo na paryādāya tiṣṭhati |
sbh2.0:104.172: yāmupasthāpayati yoniśo manasikārasaṁprayuktā smṛtiḥ pra ti mukhe khī tyucyate |
sbh2.0:104.174: api ca samādhinimittālambanā pratibhālambanā smṛtiḥ pratimukhe khī tyucyate |
sbh2.0:105.1: tatra cittavyapakarṣaḥ yaḥ kliṣṭamavyākṛtaṁ ca manaskāraṁ ca varjayitvā |
sbh2.0:105.2: samāhitabhūmikaṁ vā samādhisaṁbhāraprāyogikaṁ vā manaskāraṁ bhāvayati |
sbh2.0:105.14: ye dharmā udgṛhītā ḥ śrutā, yā cāvavādānuśāsanī pratilabdhā bhavati |
sbh2.0:105.15: gurubhyastāmadhipatiṁ kṛtvā samāhitabhūmikanimittaṁ saṁmukhīkṛtya tadālambanāṁ pravāhayuktāṁ smṛtimanuvarttayati |
sbh2.0:105.26: yā punarabhikṣayākārānichidrā niśchidrā nirantarā smṛtiḥ pravartate |
sbh2.0:105.27: tenālambanena satataṁ ca satkṛtya ceyaṁ pravāhayuktatā |
